description:
Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.

 RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

 Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

 At a Glance

 This is an individual contributor role on our Content Platform team with a focus on enhancing and maintaining our internal content workflow and content distribution systems. This role provides the opportunity to work alongside Staff and Senior engineers, broaden your experience,  and grow in your career, all while working in a friendly and supportive environment.

 Where You'll Be

 Location: Minneapolis, MN | Hybrid or Remote 

 We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we’re in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish.

 Office address: 11000 Optum Cir Eden Prairie, MN 55344

 
 
 What You’ll Do

 
 Design, build, and ship features across our content platform, working from requirements through to production.

 Partner with your Product Manager, Technical Project Manager, and fellow engineers to scope work, estimate effort, and plan sprints.

 Write clean, well-tested code and participate actively in code review, both giving and receiving feedback.

 Debug and resolve issues across the stack, supporting production systems as part of the team's on-call rotation.

 Use AI tools to reduce engineering turnaround time, and optimize your solutions for the best results.

 Contribute to a healthy team culture: clear communication, constructive code review, and shared ownership of quality.

 
 What We’re Looking For

 Required:  

 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, a related field; or equivalent experience.

 2+ years experience in software development, with a focus on large-scale applications.

 Proficiency in multiple programming languages, with a focus on Golang (e.g., Go, PHP, JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, C++, etc.).

 Deep understanding of software development methodologies and best practices.

 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

 Experience with software testing.

 Experience using AI for code generation and ideation.

 
 Preferred: 

 
 Full stack programming experience with multiple languages and technologies including Go, PHP, Node.js + TypeScript, GraphQL, REST APIs, NoSQL, etc.

 Proficiency in AWS cloud infrastructure and IaC.

 Previous experience with healthcare regulations and compliance requirements.

 
 Pursuant to various state Fair Pay Acts, below is a summary of compensation elements for this role at the company. The following benefits are provided by RVO Health, subject to eligibility requirements. 

 
 Starting Salary: $97,500 - $125,000*
 *Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience 

 Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision) 

 Life Insurance 

 Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance 

 Flexible Spending Accounts 

 Paid Time Off 

 Holiday Pay 

 401(k) with match 

 Employee Assistance Program 

 Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program 

 Pharmacy Benefits

 Income Protection Plans

 Pet Services Plans

 Mental Health Support

 Wellness Coaching

 HSA- Health Savings Account

 Commuter Benefits

 Gym & Fitness Center Discount Program

 
 Who We Are:  

 RVO Health is a health-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group’s Optum. Together, we’ve brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. We're the #1 source for doctor search in the U.S. Every day, people turn to our brands in moments that matter to find reliable health information, connect with doctors, save money on prescriptions, and take meaningful action on their wellbeing.

 RVO Health is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at RVO Health is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications.   

 We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodations@rvohealth.com .

 We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time. 

 #LI-Hybrid
